Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse is a locally organized healthcare cluster in Denmark. It is specifically tracked in the "Atrieflimren i Danmark" (Atrial Fibrillation in Denmark) report published by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP), which monitors clinical quality indicators for the treatment and surveillance of atrial fibrillation patients [^src1]. 

The cluster is significant because its results for both Indikator 9 and Indikator 12 are presented separately in the report, highlighting its specific performance metrics regarding heart failure development and mortality [^src1]. Notably, the data reveals that Sundhedsklyngen Slagelse experiences a higher 1-year mortality rate than the national average [^src1]. For instance, the cluster's records on page 82 show 487 events out of 5,798 patients, corresponding to an 8.4% rate [^src1]. Furthermore, the statistics on page 84 indicate 136 events out of 867 patients, resulting in a 15.7% rate against a baseline of 12.3% [^src1]. These figures are utilized for benchmarking, clinical development, and political governance of treatment quality within the Danish healthcare system [^src1].
